title: CAT 2024 Question Paper (Slot 3, QA) - Quant - Progressions
subject: Quant

questions.q: Consider the sequence $t_1=1, t_2=-1$ and $t_n=(\frac{n-3}{n-1}) t_{n-2}$ for $n \geq 3$. Then, the value of the sum $\frac{1}{t_2}+\frac{1}{t_4}+\frac{1}{t_6}+\cdots+\frac{1}{t_{2022}}+\frac{1}{t_{2024}}$, is:
questions.explain: This is a telescoping series. By calculating the first few terms, a pattern emerges that simplifies the sum significantly. The sum S = $\sum_{k=1}^{1012} \frac{1}{t_{2k}}$. After simplifiQuantion, this leads to a large negative number.
